description: Process Flows (Application → Process Flows): build a user/business process across the app's pages by hand — name it, write a description, and list the pages it goes through in order (start → next → …), each with a note — then generate a process-flow document (print-ready HTML → PDF; the description can be drafted by the AI chosen in AI settings). Kept per VB Studio project on this PC (desktop/lib/processFlows.js at /__pflow/*).

available.description: The local server has Process Flows (the desktop app).

flow.description: The flow being edited: { id, name, description, area, owner, status, pages: [{ id, page, name, note }] }.

saved.description: The flow as last saved (to tell unsaved changes).

pages.description: The app's page catalog, for the page-name list ({ id, label }).

appLabel.description: The app the pages belong to, named on the document.

busy.description: save | pdf | html | ai, while it runs.

view.description: The editor view: edit (the form + pages) or preview (the card document, exportable to PDF).

doc.description: The generated document to preview: { html }.

ai.description: A description drafted by AI, to use or discard: { text, provider }.

pageApis.description: A page's APIs, cached by catalog page id: { loading, list: [{ method, name, path, writes }], error }.

apisOpen.description: Which editor rows have their APIs list open, by row id.

recording.description: A live recording from the real app: { running, steps: [{ name }], skipped, busy, error }.
